(i) L$_2$-regularization and weight-decay regularization are not equivalent for adaptive gradient algorithms such as Adam; (ii) we propose a modification of these algorithms that restores their original formulation, and (iii) this modification improves the generalization performance of Adam on standard image classification tasks.
